drill.title: The blackout drill
drill.lede: Twenty minutes, once a quarter. Airplane mode on, wifi off, phone unplugged. The goal is not to feel prepared — it is to find the thing that does not work while it is still cheap to fix.

phases.name: Before
items: Charge the phone to 100% and unplug it. Note the starting percentage.
Turn on airplane mode. Do not just disconnect from wifi.
Force-quit Files and Kiwix so nothing is cached in memory.
Put the second stick somewhere you would actually look for it in the dark.

phases.name: During
items: Open one PDF from the stick and scroll to its last page.
Open one PDF from On My iPhone, not from the stick.
Open a Kiwix article and search three different terms.
Answer three questions you do not know by heart: a water dose, a canning time, a first-aid step. Time yourself.
Fill a glass from your stored water and drink it.
Light the stove, or the lantern, and use only that light for ten minutes.

phases.name: After
items: Write what failed, with the date, in 04-notes/drill-log.txt.
Fix one thing before you put the phone back on the network.
Note the battery percentage you ended on, and charge the power bank.
Copy the updated notes to both sticks.

drill.pass: Every file opens, three questions get answered in under 3 minutes each, and the phone loses less than 25% battery in the whole drill.

unknowns.claim: Kiwix can open a ZIM straight from a USB-C stick on iPhone
unknowns.detail: The project tracker has a 2020 request marked completed and a 2019 failure report. Assume it does not work, keep ZIMs on the phone, and test it yourself before relying on it.

unknowns.claim: A local model fits comfortably in iPhone 15 memory
unknowns.detail: No verified figure exists for how much memory a given model needs on this phone. Start with the smallest file and measure heat, speed and battery drain on your own device.

unknowns.claim: PocketPal or LLM Farm can search your PDFs and cite pages
unknowns.detail: Neither app is confirmed to index your library or show page sources. Assume it cannot until you have done it yourself.

unknowns.claim: The Army record pages still describe current editions
unknowns.detail: The v2 notes record PUB_ID 1005316 and 1032023 as ACTIVE but did not capture their titles. Open the pages, read the distribution statement on the cover, and update the note.
FEMA says the files will not be updated regularly after September 30, 2025. Treat the hazard numbers as historical and check your local emergency agency.

unknowns.claim: The 2002 first-aid manual reflects current medical practice
unknowns.detail: It is a field refresher. Take a current first-aid and CPR course, and follow current guidance over any manual on this shelf.

unknowns.claim: Free downloads are free to reuse
unknowns.detail: Every shelf card carries a licence class. Public domain is public domain; free-to-read is not. Where the terms are unclear, keep it personal and do not repost it.

rotation.task: Run the blackout drill and log the result
Check the two Army record pages for a newer edition
Open every file on both sticks, end to end
Copy the notes folder to both sticks
Rotate pantry stock and check dates
Replace stored water and liquid bleach
Replace batteries, test the radio and the headlamp
Retake a first-aid course or at least the refresher
